elements.label: Connection and sync labels
elements.usage: Show communication and pending changes; they are browser status, not hardware settings.
elements.action: Sign in with POST /api/session; sign out with POST /api/logout.

elements.label: Network
elements.usage: Open the dialog and copy a LAN address for another device. Keep the Mac and service running.
elements.action: Copy is a local browser action.

elements.label: Auto / Intel / AMD
elements.usage: Select the saved macOS graphics policy. External displays require discrete AMD; policy does not identify which GPU an app is using.
elements.action: POST /api/graphics with mode auto, intel or amd.

elements.label: Claude and Codex
elements.usage: Percentages used, window labels, reset countdown and update/reset tooltips. Readings older than 30 minutes dim. These are usage observations.
elements.action: Read-only. Sign-in/setup belongs to each provider's CLI on the Mac.

elements.label: Battery
elements.usage: Charge percentage, power source and charging state of the host Mac.

elements.label: Tailscale
elements.usage: Host connection state; green requires Running and online.

elements.label: Brightness and Volume
elements.usage: Drag the 0–100 slider or use the end buttons to change by five points.
elements.action: POST /api/control with control brightness or volume and numeric value.

elements.label: Brightness / Backlight / Sound On–Off
elements.usage: Off preserves the previous positive level. On restores it; sound Off mutes. Brightness Off persists against external resets.
elements.action: POST /api/toggle with control brightness, keyboard or volume and boolean enabled.

elements.label: Display sleep
elements.usage: Sleep requests actual display sleep; Wake releases it and restores brightness. A positive brightness command/preset also wakes it. Choice is saved.
elements.action: POST /api/control with control displaySleep and numeric value 1 for Sleep or 0 for Wake.

elements.label: Built-in Keyboard and Trackpad
elements.usage: Toggle physical built-in inputs independently. External inputs remain available. Both start enabled after reboot/helper restart.
elements.action: POST /api/inputs with device keyboard or trackpad and boolean enabled.

elements.label: Backlight and Automatic
elements.usage: Backlight adjusts keyboard illumination; Automatic follows ambient light. Physical keyboard input is a separate control.
elements.action: POST /api/control with control keyboard (0–100) or keyboardAuto (numeric 0/1).

elements.label: Media Previous / Play / Next
elements.usage: Send media keys. Play is a play/pause command; it is not a reported playback state.
elements.action: POST /api/media with action previous, play or next.

elements.label: Quick presets
elements.usage: Workday, After hours and Quiet time apply brightness, backlight, volume and mute. Unsupported controls are skipped.
elements.action: POST /api/presets with preset work, evening or quiet.

elements.label: Auto / Constant / Target / Max fans
elements.usage: Auto returns control to Apple. Constant saves bounded RPM per fan on slider release. Target saves a 50–85°C CPU goal on blur or Enter. Max selects each fan's firmware maximum.
elements.action: POST /api/fans with mode; add speeds for constant or temperature for target.

elements.label: CPU / Intel / AMD temperatures and fan RPM
elements.usage: Celsius readings and actual RPM, with firmware maximum. Target's forecast, headroom and learning count describe the controller.
elements.action: Measurements are read-only; select fan mode to change cooling.

elements.label: USB drive cards
elements.usage: Show eligible connected external USB volumes. Mount/unmount with the card button. Unlock requests a password only for a locked volume.
elements.action: POST /api/drives with id and boolean mounted; optional password when mounting.

elements.label: Setup/help buttons
elements.usage: Open instructions for installing or granting permission to helpers on the host Mac.
elements.action: Opening instructions has no hardware action; installation is performed on the host.

elements.label: ? guide
elements.usage: Open this guide, API reference and live JSON contracts.

elements.label: Intel GPU utilization
elements.fields_and_units: history[].intelGpu, percent; intelGpuInfo contains device state

elements.label: AMD GPU utilization
elements.fields_and_units: history[].amdGpu, percent; amdGpuInfo contains device state

elements.label: RAM utilization and free memory
elements.fields_and_units: history[].ram, percent used; memory.used/total/compressed, bytes. Free = total minus used; UI labels binary GiB as GB.

elements.label: Network download and upload
elements.fields_and_units: history[].download/upload, bytes per second; interfaces lists included interfaces

elements.label: Expanded activity charts
elements.fields_and_units: Same series; Now is latest sample, Average and Peak use available samples in the two-minute window. Expanded RAM also shows bytes and free fraction.

elements.label: Temperature / cooling readings
elements.fields_and_units: history[].cpuTemperature/intelTemperature/amdTemperature.celsius, °C; fans[].rpm/minimum/maximum/target, RPM; fanController includes prediction and target metadata

elements.label: 1h / 12h / 24h power chart
elements.fields_and_units: history[].time/value, seconds/W; graph series may average buckets

elements.label: Daily energy chart and table
elements.fields_and_units: daily[].day/energy_wh/covered_seconds/first_sample/last_sample; Wh and seconds, up to 90 Manila calendar days

elements.label: Expanded daily summary
elements.fields_and_units: Logged total sums recorded daily Wh; average draw = energy_wh × 3600 / covered_seconds when coverage is positive

elements.label: Unbucketed power readings
elements.fields_and_units: samples[].time/watts/connected/day/cumulative_wh; exact stored observations, including nulls and continuity boundaries

elements.label: Copy progress bars
elements.fields_and_units: Notifier transfers, file_activity and finder_progress observations, including byte counts, percentages and current-file details
